privacy.note: All owner repositories may be inventoried privately, but public Pages publishes only aggregate private counts and public-repository details. Private repository names, URLs, SHAs, notes and findings are excluded.

self_audit.reason: The control repository is private; its name and audit payload are not published in the public Pages snapshot.

signals.message: Persistent deep scanning of private repositories requires an Actions credential with access to those repositories; the default per-repository GITHUB_TOKEN cannot provide account-wide private access.
